'''Joshpara''' is a kind of [[dumpling]] popular in [[Central Asia]], [[South Caucasus]] and the [[Middle East]]. They are made of unleavened [[wheat]] [[dough]] squares filled with [[ground meat]] and condiments.<ref name="Davidson">{{cite book | editor = Alan Davidson | author = Charles Perry | title = The Oxford Companion to Food | chapter = joshpara | page = 434 | publisher = Oxford University Press | year = 2014 | isbn = 9780199677337 | url = https://books.google.com/books?id=RL6LAwAAQBAJ&q=joshpara&pg=PA434 }}</ref>
